Acme Tools

No deployments recorded yet

DORA bands of deployment frequency, from the count of the last 30 days: on demand (multiple deploys per day) 720 and more, between once per hour and once per day 30 to 719, between once per day and once per week 5 to 29, between once per week and once per month 1 to 4; with none in the last 30 days, from the count of the last 180 days: between once per month and once every six months 1 and more, less than once per six months 0.

DORA bands of lead time for changes, from the median of the commits deployed in the last 30 days: less than one hour below 1 hour, less than one day 1 hour to below 24 hours, one day to one week 24 hours to below 7 days, one week to one month 7 days to below 30 days, one to six months 30 days to below 180 days, more than six months 180 days and more. A month is 30 days.

DORA bands of failed deployment recovery time, from the median of the recoveries in the last 30 days, each from the first failed deployment of a run to the next successful deployment of the same stream: the six bands of lead time for changes, on the same edges, as the DORA Quick Check gives the same answers for both. A failure not recovered yet is counted, not timed.

DORA bands of change fail rate, from the failed changes out of the final deployments of the last 30 days, a failed change being a failed deployment or an issue labelled failure opened in the window, per repository the larger of the two counts, so an issue about a failed deployment is not counted twice: the nearest label of the scale the DORA Quick Check shows, 0% below 10%, 20% 10% to below 30%, 40% 30% to below 50%, 60% 50% to below 70%, 80% 70% to below 90%, 100% 90% and more. The rate is shown in whole percent, rounded down.

The four DORA metrics, from data GitHub already has.
